notes:
Logging a session is much smoother. Typing on the number pad no longer reloads every exercise's history, so the screen keeps up even for clients with years of sessions.
Session lists, exercise history and deleting a session are faster. Your existing data is upgraded automatically the first time you open this version.
Importing a spreadsheet or an exercise library no longer freezes the app while the file is read.
Messages and Undo now appear in one place, at the top right, on every screen.
Deleting an exercise from a session no longer asks for confirmation. Tap Undo within 5 seconds if it was a mistake.
Fixed exporting sometimes getting stuck on the loading spinner.
Smaller download.
